messages:
rachel: hi team — starting today! quick orientation Qs: who owns billing/quotas for dedicated capacity, who signs off on data processing agreements for datasets used in evals, and who do I ping to get a hardware booking for a perf run? trying to make a week1 plan without spamming folks. :wave:
tia (people-ops): welcome rachel! :tada: short routes: billing/quotas -> finance + @josh for infra-linked quotas, DPAs / vendor/legal stuff -> @marco (security) then legal, hw bookings -> #eng-infra bookings board or DM @josh. i'll DM you a condensed contact list.
josh (eng-infra): hi rachel — for dedicated capacity quotas we use the capacity-requests form (https://internal/infra/capacity-requests). include model, expected p99 latency target, and sustained qps. finance will need estimate for cost center. tagging #eng-infra helps visibility.
nina (eng-ml): for dataset DPAs specifically tied to evals, we run a short privacy checklist before any human labeling. ping #eng-ml with the dataset id and intended tasks. if it's internal-only synthetic data, we usually skip DPA but still need a data steward signoff.
marco (security): DPA/legal: please start with a security intake ticket (https://internal/security/intake). include vendor name, data types, retention. i'll triage and loop in legal. for model licenses/permissiveness (open vs restricted) tag me and put the model URL + license in the ticket.
rachel: thanks — who approves read access to prod metrics dashboards? also where's the code review / OWNERS list for the infra repos?
josh (eng-infra): dashboards: ops-read is the standard role for dashboards. request via #access-requests with the dashboard id. OWNERS: root/OWNERS in each repo and we also maintain a team index at https://internal/repos/owners-index. quick command: `rg "owner:" -n OWNERS || git grep -n "OWNERS"`
tonight-oncall-bot: oncall schedule: primary tonight is @sara_sre, secondary @deep_sre. runbooks pinned in #incidents.
marco (security): escalation for suspicious data access: 1) page primary SRE 2) open security intake 3) call pager if PII involved. use @security in channel for high (P1) issues.
nina (eng-ml): model onboarding owner: if you're onboarding a new open model, open a model-onboard issue and assign to `team-models` — owners rotate but we do a quick triage within 48h. include sample prompts + eval metrics you expect.
tia (people-ops): propose a compact week1 schedule: Mon AM: infra creds + dashboard access with @josh, Mon PM: security intake walkthrough with @marco, Tue: model onboarding walkthrough with @nina, Wed: billing/quotas sync with finance + @josh, Thu: shadow oncall basics, Fri: 30m sync + followups. prefer calendar invites or a doc?
rachel: calendar invites please. can someone paste the minimal access request template here to save a step?
tia (people-ops): sure — post this in #access-requests or DM me if stuck:
``n
Subject: Access request — rachel — team: eng-ml
Resources: dashboards: <id>, repos: <names>, infra project: <id>
Access needed: (read/admin)
Justification: onboarding, perf runs
Duration: (temp until MM/DD)
Approver: (team owner)
``n
we usually process dashboard/read requests within 24h on weekdays. infra roles may take 2-3 days.
josh (eng-infra): small tip: when requesting hardware booking include: `model`, `seq_len`, `batch`, `expected_tokens_per_sec`, `dates` and a preferred region/GPU. helps us pre-reserve nodes.
rachel: awesome — i'll file the access req and book the calendar slots. thanks all! :pray: i'll follow up after the first shadow session.
